Estimated items served: fruit bowl (~100 kcal), soup (~120), a glass of lemonade/juice (~90), a tofu and mushroom salad (~250), 3 sushi pieces (~150), 2 rolls (~180), pickled ginger (~5), and a mug (likely tea or coffee, ~0). That totals about 895 kcal, which I round to 900.

In the second photo the plates look essentially empty. Leftovers are only sauce residue and the ginger cup, which I estimate at about 20 kcal.

Eaten is about 880 kcal. For the macros I assume roughly 15% of energy from protein, 55% from carbohydrate and 30% from fat, which comes to about 33 g protein, 120 g carbohydrate and 30 g fat.
